newsitem.title: FRANCE: France wants to be close to Germany on deficit.
newsitem.headline: France wants to be close to Germany on deficit.

text.p: The French government on Thursday said it was not clear if Germany would manage to cut its deficit to exactly 3.0 percent of GDP this year and that Paris wanted to achieve the same level of deficit as its neighbours.

"What has been held out by Germany for now is the respect of the 3.0 percent target. Will they make it? There is debate even in Germany on that point," government spokeswoman Catherine Trautmann told reporters after a cabinet meeting.

Asked whether Germany and France might work together on deficit reduction to bring about the euro, Trautmann made clear France aimed to keep its deficit at a level similar to other potential EMU participants.
"It is clear that, for France, its wish is of course, to be able to have positions that meet those of its neighbouring country," she said.
"We are also concerned by the other countries (notably) Italy which is very motivated (to cut down the deficit to the required level)," Trautmann added.
